description: Verifies a token minted by qm_attest. The inputs are agent_id, at, token, and checks, corresponding to the fields of a single qm_attest mint response. Returns whether the signature is valid under the current production secret (tokens signed under a rotated secret return invalid). Read-only; free, anonymous. Example: the four fields from a qm_attest response return a validity verdict.

checks.description: Checks array exactly as returned by qm_attest.

name: qm_attest_verify
